scope: Watchlist overview with per-symbol indicators, saved-snapshot comparisons, data-status warnings, detail navigation and manual bounded refresh.
changes: One row per saved watch symbol, using latest two historical snapshots on initial load.
Manual Refresh all and individual retry use the existing read-only research endpoint with two workers.
Progress distinguishes responses, request errors and skipped symbols; stopping drains running requests and skips queued work.
Current readings expire after 90 seconds and fall back to labelled saved snapshots. Failed requests preserve original reading clocks.
Details synchronizes the selected native chart, scrolls to the research panel and refreshes its reading.
Optional bounded history query limit preserves the existing API default and stored history.

browser.account: isolated synthetic local journal and token; public OpenTerminal market responses

limits: Market freshness, event coverage and unreported candle timeframes remain unverified.
Newly returned headline URLs are not necessarily newly published events.
Request errors and stop/worker behavior verified by deterministic tests; public browser refresh completed without request errors.
Full infrastructure suite, repository-wide coverage gate and Windows runtime not run.
Native OpenTerminal unchanged; native tests not rerun.
